title: Notifications
lead: Orbit lets you know on your phone or computer when something needs you: “My day” every morning and right away when it is urgent.

device.title: This device
device.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
device.iosInstall: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only work once Orbit is installed: in Safari tap Share → “Add to Home Screen”, open Orbit from the home screen and enable them here.
device.denied: Notifications are blocked for Orbit. Allow them in your browser or device settings and reload the page.
device.on: Notifications are on for this device.
device.off: Notifications are not on for this device yet.
device.error: That didn't work. Please try again.
device.testSent: Sent to {count, plural, =1 {1 device} other {# devices}}.

what.title: What you get
what.mydayHint: A summary every morning: meetings, tasks due, drafts, tickets. Only sent when something is on.
what.assistantHint: When Noah has created new drafts in Outlook.
what.accessHint: When your request was approved or declined.
what.appHint: New urgent items as soon as they appear.
what.statusHint: When a service goes down and comes back. Administrators only.
what.broadcast: Messages from your administrators always arrive while notifications are on for a device.

prompt.text: “My day” on your phone every morning?

admin.title: Send notifications
admin.lead: To everyone, to roles or to individual people. It reaches everyone who has notifications on for at least one device.
admin.reach: Reaches {count, plural, =0 {nobody} =1 {1 person} other {# people}} with notifications on.
